Name: Realistic Shops
Author: Ballshorse
Description:
Changes the stock in Pierre's and Jojamart to more accurately reflect a real life supermarket.

All of the regular stock in both shops are still included, this mod only adds things into them. The lists of items added are:
*All items cost the value of it's regular quality doubled and unlimited quantity*
